## Where does this belong?

This repository is a **distribution package**. `ZenUniffi.xcframework` and `Sources/` are build
artifacts produced by the `UniFFI` workflow in
[phenixrizen/zen](https://github.com/phenixrizen/zen) and pushed here.

- [ ] Packaging only (`Package.swift`, README, platform targets)
- [ ] Requires a change in `phenixrizen/zen` (link it here)
- [ ] Regenerated artifacts from a `phenixrizen/zen` release run

## Testing

- [ ] `swift build`
- [ ] Resolves as a package dependency in a sample app
